I fixed the failing test by fixing the code, not the test. All 4 tests pass now.

The test expected `addTax(19.99)` to return `24.19`, but it returned `24.1879`. The comment on `addTax` in `src/money.ts` already says the result is "rounded to cents," but the function never rounded. It now rounds to the nearest cent:

```ts
return Math.round(netAmount * (1 + TAX_RATE) * 100) / 100;
```

This also changes `Cart.grossTotal()`, which calls `addTax`, so it now returns cent-rounded amounts too.
